# sovereign-edge-brain

> Defensive publication: a personal AI you own outright — learns for years with weights unchanged, memory you can read, syncs by sound/radio/light. CC0 prior art.

sovereign-edge-brain is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by Simon Gant (UK) — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate. Source and a live page are linked below.
